triples.tail_surface: Check the pump for smooth operation after service
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 维修后检查泵运行平稳
triples.evidence_text: Check the pump for smooth operation after service.

triples.tail_surface: Submerge and soak the air screw for 5 minutes in COP tank with 2% caustic wash
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在COP槽中用2%碱洗液浸泡气塞螺钉5分钟
triples.evidence_text: Submerge and soak the air screw for 5 minutes in COP tank with 2% caustic wash.

triples.tail_surface: Scrub the blind tapped air screw hole vigorously by plunging a clean 1/2” diameter sanitary bristle pipe brush in and out of the hole for two minutes while submerged
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 浸没时用洁净1/2英寸卫生硬毛管刷剧烈往复刷洗气塞螺钉盲螺纹孔两分钟
triples.evidence_text: Scrub the blind tapped air screw hole vigorously by plunging a clean 1/2” diameter sanitary bristle pipe brush in and out of the hole for two minutes while submerged.

triples.tail_surface: Soak air screw in acid sanitiser for 5 minutes
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在酸性消毒剂中浸泡气塞螺钉5分钟
triples.evidence_text: Soak air screw in acid sanitiser for 5 minutes, then scrub blind tapped hole as described in step 3 above.

triples.tail_surface: Rinse well with clean water and blow-dry blind tapped hole with clean air
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 用清水充分冲洗并用洁净空气吹干盲螺纹孔
triples.evidence_text: Rinse well with clean water and blow-dry blind tapped hole with clean air.

triples.tail_surface: Swab test the inside of the tapped hole to determine cleanliness
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 对螺纹孔内部进行擦拭试验以确定清洁度
triples.evidence_text: Swab test the inside of the tapped hole to determine cleanliness.

triples.tail_surface: Submerge and soak the shaft for 5 minutes in COP tank with 2% caustic wash
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在COP槽中用2%碱洗液浸泡轴5分钟
triples.evidence_text: Submerge and soak the shaft for 5 minutes in COP tank with 2% caustic wash.

triples.tail_surface: Scrub the blind tapped shaft hole vigorously by plunging a clean 1/2” diameter sanitary bristle pipe brush in and out of the hole for two minutes while submerged
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 浸没时用洁净1/2英寸卫生硬毛管刷剧烈往复刷洗轴盲螺纹孔两分钟
triples.evidence_text: Scrub the blind tapped shaft hole vigorously by plunging a clean 1/2” diameter sanitary bristle pipe brush in and out of the hole for two minutes while submerged.

triples.tail_surface: Soak shaft in acid sanitiser for 5 minutes
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在酸性消毒剂中浸泡轴5分钟
triples.evidence_text: Soak shaft in acid sanitiser for 5 minutes, then scrub blind tapped hole as described in step 4 above.

triples.tail_surface: assemble stud bolt (7a) in shaft (7), only finger tight (no torque)
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 将双头螺柱(7a)装入轴(7)，仅手紧（不施加扭矩）
triples.evidence_text: After approved swab test, assemble stud bolt (7a) in shaft (7), only finger tight (no torque)
